test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 40 people were employed who could together make 60 toys in 8 hours, but 8 people left just before work was to begin. How many toys could then be made in 12 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

40 men can make 60 toys in 8 hours

**Calculations:**

1 men can make toys in 8 hours = (60)/(40) = (3)/(2) toys

32 men can make toys in 8 hours = 32 × ((3)/(2)) = 48 toys

32 men can make toys in 1 hours = (48)/(8) = 6 toys

32 men can make toys in 12 hours 12 × 6 = 72 toys.

**∴ 32 men can make 72 toys in 12 hours.**
